name: P8b - evidence-preserving revision of internal concepts
preserved: P8 verdict INCONCLUSIVE and its R1/R2 numbers unchanged; c0/c2 described as useful anonymous concepts in two narrow bodies, not as a self-made language

scenarios.stable: R1 (E1) revised with E2 from the same world
scenarios.drift: world rule changed (fs: move accepts directories; view: grp:ext allowed on a filtered panel), E3 = 600 new exploration steps per body in the changed world; drift starts from each condition's stable-scenario state

conditions: FIXED (all records, human concepts + learner v4)
measures: prediction on unseen situations (stable: original world; drift: changed world, changed tool vs other tools)
new-task completion (stable: fs 60 / view 20 test tasks; drift: 20 drift tasks per body needing the changed capability)
past-task retention = share of tasks solved by R1 that remain solved after the update (stable: original world; drift: changed world, tasks not relying on the changed tool)
decisions: revise / hold / re-verify counts, verification experiments, wrong revisions

common: test process did not access experience logs

overall.FAIL: neither; analyse and record the cause

known_limits: re-verification experiments run in a sandbox of the current world

amendments.checked_with: R1 built from E1 (a training artefact) and the true models only; no revision on E2/E3 and no test was run

changes.what: view drift replaced: group_filtered -> compare_replace (compare may replace an existing comparison view; a target that is a list panel still fails; effects unchanged)
changes.why: R1's view group rule is one conjunction (panel, grp) without the filter condition: the 11 training failures (filtered panel + grp:ext) stay unexplained because a single conjunction cannot express 'filter all OR value none', so no evidence for that condition is stored. Removing a condition ATANOR never learned would not test revision. R1 holds compare's condition "target absent" with 21 stored counter-examples.

changes.what: view drift tasks: the comparison view cmp currently compares p1; make it compare p3 (filter and sort of p3) without ever closing it (kind cmp = compare kept all the way; close not granted)
changes.why: needs the changed capability: 20/20 solved by the changed-world truth, 0/20 by the original truth in the original world

changes.what: fs drift detail: a folder cannot move into itself (the world rejects it explicitly; before, the rename raised an error)
changes.why: found when validating the changed-world truth (it predicted success for those cases)

changes.what: changed-tool prediction split. (a) changed situations = actions of the changed tool where the original and the changed true rule disagree, >= 20 checks from blocks shaped like the drift tasks (indices 1000-2999, disjoint from the 20 evaluation tasks) and test blocks: the registered thresholds >= 0.90 and >= R1_KEEP + 20 pp apply here. (b) the changed tool's other situations (20 true successes + 20 true failures): joins 'other-tool prediction >= 0.95'.
changes.why: the P8 stratified sampler draws few changed situations, so R1 would score about 0.9 on the changed tool without any revision and the +20 pp criterion could not be met by anyone. Validation with true models: changed-world truth 1.00 (a) / 1.00 (b), original truth 0.00 (a) / 1.00 (b) in both bodies.

changes.what: re-verification: re-creates the conflicting situation = stored conjunction minus the condition, plus the argument types (first raw attribute) the conflicting new success had; runs in a fresh exploration block of the current world (stable: original world, drift: changed world), at most 40 blocks per verification; a new success explained by another rule of the same tool is not a conflict
changes.why: a first version picked any action lacking the condition (e.g. an absent source), which fails in both worlds

changes.what: details fixed: E3 = explore(seed 31, 600 steps, contrast-kind) per body in the changed world; prediction seeds 9100 + 10*drift + view, changed-tool seeds 9300 + view (+2 for (b)); R2_P8 drift = P8 revise(R2 stable, E3); FULL_RAW/FULL_STRUCT/CASE/FIXED use E1+E2 (stable) and E1+E2+E3 (drift); training-situation exclusion includes E3
changes.why: implementation detail not fixed in v1

amendments.unchanged: all PASS thresholds, conditions, budget, measures and the overall verdict rule
